## Which endpoint does this affect?

- [ ] `/icons`
- [ ] `/card`

## What type of feature is this?

- [ ] New parameter (e.g., new customization option)
- [ ] New widget or data source (e.g., a new type of card stat)

## What problem does this solve?

<!--
